artworks.title: Andreas Velleius (Anders Sorensen Vedel)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 31 x 21.4 cm (12 3/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a man from the chest up, facing right. He has a prominent nose, a full beard, curly hair under a cap, and is wearing a textured outer garment with a patterned standing collar. The background is a textured gradient darkening towards the right side. Below the image is a caption that reads "ANDREAS VELLEIVS," framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: The Coronation of Solomon by the Spring of Gihon
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor, heightened with white gouache
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a seated figure being crowned by surrounding figures in a tent-like structure. There is a small body of water with rocky banks in the foreground, and a row of trees leading into the background towards a pastoral landscape with rolling hills and distant trees. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing contours and textures, with a soft and muted color palette of earthy tones dominating the composition.

artworks.title: Banks of the Seine at Médan
artworks.description: The image features a cluster of trees with wispy foliage rising into the sky. The horizon is close to the bottom edge, with the tree tops silhouetted against it. The watercolor piece uses fluid brushstrokes and overlapping washes of color. The color palette includes light blues, greens, and earthy tones, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The sky is a pale blend of blue and cream, adding to the dreamy feel of the image.

artworks.title: St. Paul's Cathedral, Valetta, Malta, with Bell Tower
artworks.creditLine: The Carolyn Brody Fund and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a ground-level view of a large and classical building with prominent columns and ornate capitals on the left side. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is on the tall architecture and adjacent structures. The photo is in sepia tones, giving it an antique feel. Besides the columns, there is a tower structure with arched windows and detailed stonework. On the right, a high wall leads to another building with balconies and window grids against a smooth stone exterior. The scene lacks people and emphasizes architectural elements under soft lighting, creating a serene and slightly timeless impression.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a young child standing upright. The child has a serious expression with short, light brown hair. They are wearing a long beige dress with blue accents, including a large blue bow at the neck and decorative blue patterns throughout. The child is standing on a yellow surface with black swirl patterns and the background is plain dark grey.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a child posing while standing on an upholstered chair. The child has short, neatly combed brown hair and features a calm expression. They are dressed in a dark, long-sleeved garment with a large lace collar, dark stockings, and shoes. The chair is upholstered in dark fabric and the background is a neutral gray.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Baby
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a baby seated on a chair. The baby is sitting upright, supported by the chair's back, facing forward. The baby has short, dark hair and blue eyes, with a neutral expression. The baby is wearing a light-colored off-the-shoulder dress with lace trim. The chair is upholstered in dark fabric with floral patterns and fringe detail. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with long dark hair. She wears an ornate gown with a train, fur trim, and a crown. The background includes a wall with a painted scene of clouds and a landscape.

artworks.title: A Peep from Upper Lake Road showing Temple and Island with Park -- fruit tree in foreground
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a scenic landscape with water and architecture in the distance. The horizon is high, with the water's edge and buildings lining it. A tree with large fruits and dense foliage frames the view closely, its branches extending across the upper section of the image. The photographic technique captures clear lines and textures. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia or brown tones highlighting details like tree textures and the water's stillness. In the background, there are rolling hills covered with thick trees.

artworks.title: Ruins of Martand from Southeast
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins stretching into the distance, with weathered stone structures, arched openings, and pillars. The composition obscures the horizon with the ruins, focusing on the architecture. The scene has a monochromatic, sepia-toned color palette highlighting textures and shadows. The foreground has grass and shrubs, and the clear sky emphasizes the isolation of the ruins.

artworks.title: Agricultural Scene with Mountains
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a countryside or garden setting. There is a small building or shed with a tiled roof on the right. Rows of vegetables or plants are hanging from the structure. A pathway is on the left, with stone pillars marking the entrance. Bare tree branches overhead suggest the season might be winter or early spring. In the background, there is dense foliage, shrubbery, and a mountain against the sky. The photograph is in sepia tone, emphasizing the natural elements and the structure.

artworks.title: River Scene
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene. The viewpoint is at eye level, with a rocky bank and dense vegetation obscuring the horizon. The rocks and foliage create a barrier, directing focus to the reflective water. The river's surface is calm and mirrors the surroundings. Lush vegetation spans both sides of the image. The photo is in sepia tones, highlighting textures and creating a tranquil aesthetic.

artworks.title: Ancient Oak in the Bois de Boulougne
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene with a prominent tree in the center. The horizon is low with smaller trees and bushes in the distance. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the tree's texture and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and beige. Two figures are depicted near the base of the tree. In the background, smaller trees and undergrowth are clustered, creating a serene natural setting.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure carrying another figure on its shoulders through a body of water. The scene depicts motion and struggle as the large figure supports the smaller figure with a long staff. The smaller figure is encircled by radiating lines. The sky has swirling lines indicating strong winds, and there are distant architectural outlines visible. Strong lines and cross-hatching create texture and depth in the drawing.

artworks.title: Desert Landscape with a Hermit (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a seated figure in the foreground, looking out towards a horizon with trees or structures. Ink strokes depict movement in the trees above and texture in the ground below. The color palette is monochrome with variations of black and gray on beige paper. The lines create hills and trees, evoking a sense of tranquility and contemplation.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing capturing a busy scene filled with figures, trees, and architectural elements. The composition is dense with figures and foliage, with ruins of classical architecture at the center. The drawing uses intricate line work and fine hatching to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white. Various characters and animals populate the scene, with diverse clothing and postures showing a lively and narrative quality. In the distance, more trees frame the composition, and small figures fade into the background. The sky above features heavenly figures and angels, adding an ethereal element to the scene below.

artworks.title: Presentation Drawing of the Hôtel de Camondo
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the façade of a grand building. The central structure is flanked by two symmetrical wings. The central portion features embellishments, such as carvings above the main entrance and moldings around the windows. The building displays a mix of classical and baroque architectural elements, like rounded arches and pilasters. The roof is steeply pitched with dormer windows. The composition conveys grandeur and opulence.

artworks.title: A Muse
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk heightened with white on pinkish-tan paper, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a graceful, airborne pose with arms outstretched, holding billowing fabric. She has delicate facial features, wavy hair framing her face, and wears a flowing garment. The sketch is in charcoal or pencil with a plain background showing a faint grid pattern.

artworks.title: An Extensive River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and black wash, varnished
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with various elements. There are large trees and rugged foliage in the foreground, leading to a horizon with mountains and fading landscapes. The horizon sits halfway up the image, where land meets the sky with clouds. The brushwork is detailed, capturing textures of trees and rocky terrain. The color scheme is warm sepia tones. Shadows and highlights add depth. In the distance, a small arched bridge crosses water, connecting dense trees to hills leading to the horizon.

artworks.title: Harrowing--View near the Cross Fells
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with scratching out on wove paper
artworks.description: The painting shows a pastoral scene with a stone wall and gate in the foreground. In the distance, there is a mountain range under a dramatic sky with dynamic clouds. The color palette includes earthy browns and greens contrasting with the cooler hues of the sky. The landscape features plowed fields with two sets of horses being used for farming, and figures directing their work. Light and shadow are balanced in the painting, highlighting the contrast between the dark clouds and the illuminated fields.

artworks.title: Lincoln Cathedral from the Castle Moat
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a medieval structure with towers and a spire, potentially a cathedral, in the distance. Surrounding the structure are lush trees extending from the foreground to the horizon. The sky above transitions from light blue to warm orange and pink tones. The brushwork appears delicate and impressionistic, with soft blending in the sky and foliage. The color palette consists of earthy tones dominated by variations of green and brown. The composition creates a tranquil and timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Enchanted Castle at Dusk
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with touches of gold on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a ruined castle on a rocky hill, with a high horizon blending into an orange sky. Birds are flying against the sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing texture on the stone structures and foliage. The color palette includes warm earth tones like browns and oranges. The trees and close vegetation are well-defined, while distant hills are blurred for depth.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Disciples
artworks.dimensions:
image: 12.7 x 9.8 cm (5 x 3 7/8 in.)
sheet: 13 x 10.1 cm (5 1/8 x 4 in.)

artworks.title: Tourelle, Rue de l'École de Médecine, 22, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching shows an upward view of a city scene with historical architecture. It includes a corner of a building with a turret and spire, and a glimpse down a narrow street. The buildings guide the eye to a crowded street scene. The technique features cross-hatched lines for a detailed textural effect in the stonework and street. The color palette is black ink on cream paper. The sky has swirling clouds and birds. People and carriages add life to the street scene, framed by architectural details.
